source_values: Saved 5.3 test_predictions.npz prediction and target arrays, aligned by test sample index and time coordinate.
selection: Retain the low individual fixed for figure 5-1. At the user's request, replace the high and median individuals by the nearest alternatives to their observed-level quantiles (90th percentile and median). All plotted trajectories are read from 5.3.

replacements.requested_change: Another high-observed-level individual for visual inspection.
replacements.rule: Nearest alternative to the 90th percentile of mean observed test phenotype, excluding the original high-level individual; ties use original row index.

replacements.requested_change: Another median-observed-level individual for visual inspection.
replacements.rule: Nearest alternative to the median of mean observed test phenotype, excluding the original median individual and the displayed low/high individuals; ties use original row index.

display: Upper row: observed points and predicted values joined by straight segments across all 20 saved time points. Lower row: predicted minus observed values on the same original simulation scale. No smoothing.
uncertainty: Individual predictions from one fixed repeat; no interval bands.
